scenario: Underscore separators in float literals per LLEX.11.1 — `1_000.5_00` and `1_000e1_0` are valid float literals. Pin: a where clause using both forms compiles OK.
rules_ds:
schema S scope logical:
    v: Float key

rule r:
    S s where s.v == 1_000.5_00 or s.v == 1_000e1_0
->
    log info "ok"
